rationales.1: The no-motion parity renders lay out all three acts with every diagram fully drawn and every disclosed figure present, in a layout indistinguishable from the motion set. Equality of experience is essentially total here.
rationales.2: The first-viewport headline names the product and its living context, and the subhead immediately names the audience and the real problem. Nothing about that clarity depends on motion completing.
rationales.3: All three qualified figures (n=14 median setup, CAD-estimated volume, certification-pending load) carry their caveats inline and bolded. Price and trial terms sit next to the hero, stated plainly.
rationales.4: Play and Skip controls sit together in the header across every render, and the quoted gate evidence confirms native scroll, no wheel capture, and a working skip/second-visit bypass.
rationales.5: A single door-and-bed scale motif recurs across all three acts and holds its line weight and spacing in both light and dark captures. Cinematic and static registers read as one system.
rationales.6: Budgets are met with wide margin on payload and LCP, though desktop frame time sits essentially at the stated ceiling rather than comfortably under it. No slow-device-specific design beyond the shared reduced-motion floor is described.
rationales.7: The captures show a literal domestic-scale progression, bag against a door, unfold on the floor, water withheld until act three, that ties directly to the product's carry-and-storage promise. Full choreography can't be confirmed from stills, but what's shown and what's declared both point the same direction.
rationales.8: Only the two declared breaks are visible: no water in the first two viewports, and a domestic reference object staying on screen throughout. Ordering and navigation mechanics stay conventional around them.
rationales.9: Lines like "which is the whole trick and also the whole objection you are about to raise" are specific to this boat's storage argument. No competitor selling a different fold could run this copy unchanged.
rationales.10: A header "Specs and price" link plus a passing second-visit-bypass gate give a returning visitor the static view with price fully visible immediately, without replaying the narrative.

rationales.1: Every fact and all three counts are present in the no-motion render, but the partially filled rings for counts one and two read ambiguously as a stalled progress bar rather than a deliberately finished illustration. That is a real, if modest, equality-of-experience gap next to the other two candidates' fully resolved static drawings.
rationales.2: The subhead names the product and audience within the first viewport, but the headline itself, "Three counts: bag, unfold, water," is abstract and doesn't say what this is on its own. Clarity arrives a beat later than the other two candidates.
rationales.3: The three qualified figures carry the same required caveats as the sealed data demands, plus an extra honest line that the dial itself is not timing the visit. This second disclosure is a nice touch not required by the brief.
rationales.4: Skip and Play controls are equally visible in the header, and the quoted gate evidence for native scroll and second-visit bypass matches the other two candidates.
rationales.5: The ring-and-numeral system is clean and holds up in both themes, but the page reads sparser than the other two candidates' fuller illustrations, leaning more on typography than drawn content.
rationales.6: Budgets are met with comfortable margin, but this candidate posts the weakest numbers of the three, a 964ms mobile LCP and the tightest frame times, even though all remain well inside the ceilings.
rationales.7: The captures show no visual bag, hull, or water transformation anywhere, only text beside abstract progress rings standing in for the product's actual unfold. On the anti-spectacle test this is the weakest of the three from what the stills show, though the motion-is-real gate and declared clock-as-ornament concept mean a full verdict awaits actual choreography.
rationales.8: Both declared breaks, the elapsed-time ornament and the jump-link specs, are the only deviations visible. The jump-link break lands softer than declared, since a header specs link exists on all three candidates anyway.
rationales.9: The dial conceit is clever and self-aware, but as a counting-clock device it reads closer to a generic UX pattern than something only this boat's fold could justify.
rationales.10: This is the shortest page of the three, with specs one jump away and price visible immediately on return, most directly answering the second-visit concern its own direction intent names.

rationales.1: The no-motion render shows all three steps' text plus one fully inked final plan-sheet drawing and a complete spec grid; nothing reads as partial or degenerate. Equality of experience with the motion set is essentially total.
rationales.2: The headline states what this is and where it lives, and the fact-dense subhead adds audience and both key dimensions before any motion plays. Clarity is immediate and complete in the first viewport.
rationales.3: All three qualified figures carry their required caveats in the spec grid, worded to the same substance the sealed data demands. Price and trial terms are stated plainly alongside.
rationales.4: Skip and Play controls are visible in the header, with Play given the highlighted treatment here rather than Skip, and gate evidence matches the other two candidates for native scroll and bypass.
rationales.5: The blueprint line-work, leader-line labeling, and single accent color hold together cleanly across both themes, with the dark capture particularly suited to the plan-sheet register.
rationales.6: This candidate posts the best measured numbers of the three, fastest LCP on both viewports and the lowest interaction latency, while staying inside every stated budget.
rationales.7: The captures show an actual to-scale line drawing of the folded bag resolving into the hull with crease marks and dimension callouts, the most literal visual demonstration of the fold among the three. Remove the product and there is no plan sheet left to draw, which is the strongest match to the anti-spectacle test the stills can support.
rationales.8: The no-photo, pure line-work break is fully honored throughout. But a conventional label-value spec table also appears lower on the page despite the declared break stating dimensions would run as drawing callouts "not as a spec table," a minor tension between the stated and observed break.
rationales.9: "You watch the boat be explained rather than advertised" is carried through in genuinely technical, plan-sheet-register copy. No beauty-shot competitor could run this voice unchanged.
rationales.10: A header specs link and a passing second-visit-bypass gate give instant access to the full spec table and price on return, on par with the other narrative-length candidate.
